entities.name: Chōtoku Kyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chotoku Kyan  was an Okinawan karate master who was famous for both his karate skills and his colorful personal life. He had a large influence on the styles of karate that would become Shorin-Ryu and its related styles.
